title: Stretch marks
caption: Stretch marks form when the skin's middle layer — the dermis — tears under rapid tension, leaving scar tissue that shows through the surface. The colour shift from red or purple to silver-white isn't the mark getting worse; it's the wound healing, the same way any scar fades over time. That distinction matters because red or pink marks are still active and tend to respond better to treatment than older, white ones. Knowing where yours sit in that timeline is the first question worth asking. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
